# The Hyp Engine

> Media agency that builds and runs websites, brand identity, creative, and media campaigns for growth-stage businesses - built around revenue, not vanity metrics.

The Hyp Engine is a media agency for D2C, SaaS, app, and B2B brands. One team handles the website, the brand, the content and creative, and the paid/organic media that drives traffic - instead of clients juggling separate freelancers and agencies.

## Services

- [SEO](https://www.thehypengine.com/seo/) - organic search growth, technical audits, content built around buyer intent
- [Paid Media](https://www.thehypengine.com/paid-media/) - Google, Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels
- [Web Design & Development](https://www.thehypengine.com/web-dev/) - websites built to convert
- [Creative & Branding](https://www.thehypengine.com/creative/) - identity, design, and content systems
- [Media Production](https://www.thehypengine.com/media-production/) - video and photography
- [Social Media](https://www.thehypengine.com/social/) - content and community management
- [CRO & Automation](https://www.thehypengine.com/cro/) - conversion rate optimization and marketing automation
- AI-powered marketing (used across strategy, targeting, and creative production)

## Key facts

- Engagement model: month to month, no lock-in contracts.
- Clients can start with a single service (e.g. just the website) and expand later.
- Clients own their ad accounts, website code, creative files, and domain at all times.
- Entry point: a free marketing audit, available via the site's "Start The Audit" flow.
- Contact: contact@thehypengine.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thehypengine
